config:
model = "probe-none"
model_provider = "probe_none"
sandbox_mode = "read-only"
web_search = "disabled"

[analytics]
enabled = false

[features]
plugins = false

[model_providers.probe_none]
name = "EU-D1 probe: no model"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:9/v1"
wire_api = "responses"

[mcp_servers.double]
command = "/usr/bin/python3"
args = ["/tmp/cvx-eud1/obs1_mcp_double.py", "--log", "/tmp/cvx-eud1/logs/mcp_double.jsonl"]
